verdict.rationale: GitLab is built on Git, an inherently open format, and provides a documented API for programmatic access (gitlab-docs-7, gitlab-docs-10) plus self-hosting options (gitlab-docs-9) that let users fully own and migrate their data; community evidence also confirms straightforward migration/import of repos, issues, and PRs to/from other platforms (gitlab-comm-3). However, there is no explicit first-party documentation in this pack describing a comprehensive 'export all your data' feature (e.g., project/group export files) or guarantees for non-code artifacts like CI configs or Duo/AI data. Missing for 10: explicit project/group data-export documentation, coverage of exporting all metadata (wikis, snippets, boards) in open formats, and independent verification of full-fidelity migration success.
